Burial of Abdul Gaffar Chowdhury at Mirpur Martyred Intellectuals' Graveyard tomorrow
2022-05-27T16:13:54+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/burial-abdul-gaffar-chowdhury-mirpur-martyred-intellectuals-graveyard-tomorrow-3033161

Prominent writer and columnist Abdul Gaffar Chowdhury will be buried at Mirpur Martyred Intellectuals' Graveyard tomorrow as his body is scheduled to arrive in Dhaka under the state management from London the same day, according to a press release issued today by the foreign ministry.

A flight of Biman Bangladesh Airlines carrying his body is scheduled to arrive at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport around 11am tomorrow (May 28, 2022), said the press release.

Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Haque will formally receive the body at the airport.

Abdul Gaffar Chowdhury: His journey towards ‘immortality’ began at 17

Later, the body of Abdul Gaffar Chowdhury will be kept at the Central Shaheed Minar and Dhaka University campus from 1pm to 3pm for the people from all walks of life to pay tributes to the writer. A guard of honour is also scheduled to take place.

Around 3:3pm, his namaz-e-janaza will be held at the Dhaka University central mosque.

His body will be taken to the Jatiya Press Club at 4pm where for journalists to pay homage.

Later, Gaffar's body will be buried at Mirpur Martyred Intellectuals' Graveyard around 5:30pm, added the release.

On May 19, the writer, journalist and lyricist died of a heart attack at a hospital in London at the age of 88.

British-Bangladeshi community and other admirers paid their last respect to prominent writer and columnist Gaffar Chowdhury – best known for writing the lyrics of "Amar Bhaier Rokte Rangano" – following his first namaz-e-janaza held in London's Brick Lane mosque the following day.
